title: Persistent identity key across reboots
notes: Implemented Zephyr persistent identity lifecycle in app_identity. Added versioned exact 84-byte EUI-bound seed/public-key/CRC record plus established marker, atomic record-before-marker writes, torn-marker recovery without regeneration, one-time provisioning, fail-closed missing/corrupt/version/EUI/public-key/backend/RNG behavior, persist-before-publish, global serialization, and secret temporary-buffer wipes. Added Zephyr Settings adapter at lichen/identity/{key,established}; gated obsolete automatic link_ctx NVS tuple whenever CONFIG_LICHEN_APP_IDENTITY_PERSIST is enabled so it cannot bypass authoritative validation. Deterministic injected-backend QEMU tests cover first boot, identical reboot key, corruption/version/missing record, load/save/RNG failures, torn commit recovery, one-time provisioning, already-loaded context, and context EUI mismatch. Validation: local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 IPv6-off PASS 15/15 (app_identity 6, app_identity_store 9); qemu_x86 IPv6-on PASS 15/15; both production Settings adapter/core compiled under GCC 12 strict project warnings; git diff --check passed. cppcheck reached both files but reports the repository Monocypher header's known false syntaxError on MONOCYPHER_CPP_NAMESPACE; compiler gates are clean.
